description: This file defines a static class 'OrleansJsonSerializerSettings' which provides methods to obtain and configure default settings for JSON serialization within the Orleans framework, including handling of special types and customization options.

classes.name: OrleansJsonSerializerSettings
classes.description: Provides static methods for obtaining and configuring JSON serializer settings in the Orleans framework.

methods.name: GetDefaultSerializerSettings
methods.description: Returns the default JsonSerializerSettings with Orleans-specific configurations.

methods.name: GetDefaultSerializerSettings
methods.description: Overloaded method that accepts an IServiceProvider to produce serializer settings with potential service-based customizations.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures a JsonSerializerSettings instance by setting the SerializationBinder and adding custom converters.

methods.name: UpdateSerializerSettings
methods.description: Updates provided JsonSerializerSettings based on provided options for full assembly names, JSON indentation, and type name handling.
